description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Event' class in the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting' namespace. The class manages CRUD operations for system events, including adding, deleting, updating status, and retrieving event details from the database.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model class for managing system events in the administrative setting, extending the core engine model.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new event record into the database and returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event based on its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the active/inactive status of an event identified by its ID.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event identified by its code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the details of an event by its ID.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an event's details by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns a list of events, optionally sorted and paginated based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total count of events in the database.
